mysterious

(adjective). kỳ bí

She's an actress whose inner life has remained mysterious, despite the many interviews she has given.

musical

(adjective). liên quan tới âm nhạc

Mozart's musical compositions include symphonies and operas.

ability

(noun). năng lực

There's no doubting her ability.

distracting

(adjective). sao nhoãng

Please turn your music down - it's very distracting.

possess

(verb). sở hữu

In the past the root of this plant was thought to possess magical powers.

perfect

(adjective). hoàn hảo

What is your idea of perfect happiness?

pitch

(noun). cao độ

A basic sense of rhythm and pitch is essential in a music teacher.

solitary

(adjective). hoàn thành một mình

She enjoys long solitary walks.

reference

(noun). dẫn chứng tài liệu

She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

separate

(verb). chia rẽ

Stir the sauce constantly so that it does not separate.

relative

(adjective). Có liên quan đến

You must consider the relative merits of the two plans.

genetic

(adjective). thuộc về gen, di truyền

There are about 4 000 inherited human genetic diseases.

inheritance

(noun). Sự thừa kế

She spent all her inheritance in a year.

exposure

(noun). phơi bày

At high exposures, the chemical can affect the liver and kidneys.

combination

(noun). sự phối hợp

They recommend reducing expenditure, increasing taxes, or a combination of the two.

seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

Drivers are advised to seek alternative routes.

tone

(noun). tiếng, thanh âm

‘You ought to have thought of them,’ she said in a reproachful tone.

recite

(verb). đọc thơ

Each child had to recite a poem to the class.

read out

(verb). đọc to

Shall I read this out to you?

occasion

(noun). dịp

I've met him on several occasions.

compare

(verb). so sánh

It is interesting to compare their situation and ours.

distinct

(adjective). dễ dàng nghe, thấy, nhận biết

There was a distinct smell of gas.

cultural

(adjective). liên quan tới văn hoá

Teachers need to be aware of cultural differences.

difference

(noun). sự khác biệt

Americans and Brits speak the same language, but there are big cultural differences.

emphasis

(noun). nhấn mạnh

Since the elections there has been a greater emphasis on education.

approach

(noun). tiếp cận

She hadn't heard his approach and jumped as the door opened.

absolute

(adjective). tuyệt đối

I've joined a class for absolute beginners.

issue

(noun). vấn đề

This is a big issue; we need more time to think about it.

clear-cut

(adjective). dễ hiểu

There is no clear-cut answer to this question.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

An interesting feature of the city is the old market.

acquire

(verb). thu mua

Not all of the land acquired for the road has been paid for yet.

potential

(noun). tiềm năng

The region has enormous potential for economic development.

report

(verb). báo cáo

The crash happened seconds after the pilot reported engine trouble.

cognitive

(adjective). liên quan đến nhận thức

They are studying the links between cognitive and linguistic development in young children.

psychologist

(noun). nhà tâm lý học

I made an appointment with the school psychologist.

clearly

(adverb). rõ ràng

It's difficult to see anything clearly in this mirror.

familial

(adjective). liên quan tới gia đình

Second, does the occurrence of chronic diseases within a family change/ create perceptions of familial susceptibility?

aggregation

(noun). sự tập hợp, thu nạp

Strategic networks are an aggregation of autonomous organizations that retain their own identity.

average

(adjective). trung bình

The average age of participants was 52 years.

transcribe

(verb). Sao lại, chép lại (bằng tay)

How many official documents have been transcribed into Braille for blind people?

brilliantly

(adverb). Vẻ vang, sáng chói, rực rỡ

This is such a brillinantly simple idea.

perceive

(verb). Hiểu được, nắm được, nhận thức, lĩnh hội

This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.

elite

(noun). ưu tú

His research ought to have secured him a place in academia's elite.

previously

(adverb). trước đó

The building had previously been used as a hotel.

theorist

(noun). Nhà lý luận

Feminist theorists have long talked about the way women are represented in the media.

regardless

(adverb). Bất chấp, không đếm xỉa tới, không chú ý tới

The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless.

melodious

(adjective). Du dương, êm tai

It moves beyond the verbal text to communicate its message through sound, melodious and articulate sound.

chiefly

(adverb). quan trọng nhất

We are chiefly concerned with improving educational standards.

span

(verb). Mở rộng ra, kéo dài qua

His acting career spanned 55 years.

mind-boggling

(adjective). Dị thường; không thể tin được

It’s mind-boggling to me that this is allowed to happen.

similarity

(noun). sự giống nhau

The report highlights the similarity between the two groups.

meaningful

(adjective). có ý nghĩa

These statistics are not very meaningful.

precise

(adjective). chính xác

Can you give a more precise definition of the word?

complete

(verb). hoàn thành

She's just completed a master's degree in Law.

genius

(noun). thiên tài

Her idea was a stroke of genius.

predispose

(verb). định hướng, xúi dại

He believes that some people are predisposed to criminal behaviour.

inclination

(noun). khuynh hướng, thiên hướng

He did not show the slightest inclination to leave.

harmony

(noun). sự hài hoà

They lived together in perfect harmony.

nurture

(verb). nuôi dưỡng

These delicate plants need careful nurturing.

critical

(adjective). mang tính phê phán

You should just ignore any critical comments.

conservatory

(noun). trường nghệ thuật

At the same time, competition between conservatories led to the development of specialist courses in areas such as early music and ethnomusicology.

contend

(verb). Tranh cãi, tranh luận, tranh giành

Three armed groups were contending for power.

obscure

(adjective). không phổ biến

We went to see one of Shakespeare’s more obscure plays.

sought-after

(adjective). nhiều người mong muốn

At the age of 17 she is already one of Hollywood's most sought-after actresses.

preserve

(verb). bảo quản, giữ gìn

We want to preserve the character of the town while improving the facilities.

knack

(noun). sở trường

She has the knack of making people feel comfortable.

fine-grained

(adjective). nhỏ

This is a very fine-grained quartz.
